verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents that users can request the operator open and scan a letter's contents, beyond the envelope image, and then view the mail from phone or computer. Nothing in the pack covers searchable PDF/OCR output or any committed scan turnaround. Missing for 10: searchable PDF/OCR output, a stated same- or next-business-day scan turnaround, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
